description: All exact occurrences of a motif (case-insensitive, overlapping, ascending 0-based positions, forward strand) in a DNA sequence. IUPAC input (e.g. N runs) is accepted: a symbol other than A/C/G/T never matches, so no window containing one is an occurrence.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence: A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive); non-A/C/G/T symbols match nothing.

positions.description: Ascending 0-based start positions of every occurrence

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Motif cannot be null or empty
